title: 따릉이
scene: 한강. 민준이 공공 자전거 「따릉이」를 빌리자고 한다
goal: Renting a city bike by the Han River

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: If you're at the Han River, you gotta ride a 따릉이.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: 따릉이? The name is really cute.

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 앱으로 빌려. 한 시간에 천 원이야.
turns.rd: aebeuro billyeo. han sigane cheon woniya.
turns.en: Rent it with the app. 1,000 won an hour.

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 잠깐만, 너 자전거 탈 줄 알아?
turns.rd: jamkkanman, neo jajeongeo tal jul ara?
turns.en: Wait, do you know how to ride a bike?
turns.note: 탈 줄 알아? = do you know how to ride?

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 헐. 그럼 오늘은 걷자. 라면 먹으러.
turns.rd: heol. geureom oneureun geotja. ramyeon meogeureo.
turns.en: Whoa. Then let's walk today. To eat ramyeon.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Okay. Bike next time. Ramyeon now...
